slots.name: investment amount
slots.sentence: A $6.5 billion investment in Morocco this year marked Africa’s first electric vehicle battery gigafactory, notating a step toward transforming the continent into a global EV manufacturing hub.

slots.name: cathode investment
slots.sentence: In the past few years, Morocco signed a $300 million agreement to construct a cathode (a component critical for EVs) production unit, Afreximbank pledged $1 billion to accelerate automotive development continent-wide, and BMW launched its new BMW X3, a plug-in hybrid vehicle produced exclusively in South Africa.

slots.name: critical mineral share
slots.sentence: Africa sits on 19% of the world’s critical minerals needed for EV batteries; for example, Morocco controls 72% of the world’s phosphate reserves .

slots.name: road transport share of exports
slots.sentence: With 85% of exports to ports or airports are delivered via road transport, new companies are exploring how to reduce costs and crowdsource delivery services .
